title: Оборудование для кухни  (Equipment for the Kitchen)

segments.t: Back in the kitchen of Claude Monet, celebrity owner Dmitry Nagiyev shows off shiny boxes of high-tech culinary equipment, while head chef Viktor Barinov stubbornly defends classic French cooking.
А классика никогда не уходит из моды.
Устали люди есть одно и то же.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Beauty! Even in the boxes.' Notice how Russian expresses 'beauty' and 'boxes' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Dima, what is this?' Notice how Russian expresses 'Dima' and 'this' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Dmitry Nagiyev answers right away.
'You want to be fashionable, don't you.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'fashionable'.
'This is equipment for molecular cuisine.' Dmitry Nagiyev anchors the line on 'this', while 'kitchen' completes the thought.
'For molecular cuisine. Clear?' Dmitry Nagiyev raises the pitch on 'clear' to turn the phrase into a direct spoken question.
'Who am I talking to about fashion?' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'to whom' and 'I' in a few short words.
'We are a classic French restaurant.' In Russian, the idea of 'we' flows naturally into 'restaurant' without extra filler words.
А классика никогда не уходит из моды.
'And classics never go out of fashion.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'and' and finishing on 'fashion'.
'We do not need this cuisine.' Notice how Russian expresses 'this' and 'needed' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
Устали люди есть одно и то же.
'People are tired of eating the same thing.' The grammar packs 'got tired' and 'but' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Look for a person this very day.' Dmitry Nagiyev brings out the contrast between 'tonight' and 'but' in a few short words. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'Yes, my little chicken.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'yes', while 'little chicken' completes the thought. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
А классика никогда не уходит из моды.
Устали люди есть одно и то же.
That brings the kitchen clash to a close. Watch for Nagiyev unveiling the molecular cuisine gear and Barinov insisting that classic French food never goes out of style. See you next time!
